page_title: Item:Perfected Bracers of the Demon's Consort

enchantments.tooltip: Legendary Demonic Curse: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that your attacker will be Cursed.
Legendary Demonic Shield: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +240 Profane bonus to temporary hit points.

Utter Disintegration Guard: This item has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies that strike you and attempts to disintegrate them. This disintegrate is incredibly powerful, and will utterly destroy weaker foes.
Combat Mastery +12: +12 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Strength +14: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Damage Reduction 50/Evil: Reduces physical damage by 50, except from Evil attacks.
